children.description: Description. Annual herbs, 15 - 65 cm tall, without stolons. Primary roots thick and strong; adventitious roots numerous, shotting from the stem base, white and slightly freshy. Stems single, erect, unbranched, terete; old stems purplish brown, sparsely puberulent; young stems grayish green, densely villous and sparsely glandular hairy.
